jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Title:
Senior / Lead Cloud & AI Engineer – Agentic AI Platform (m/w/d), German-speaking

Location:
Munich (hybrid, 2–3 days in office) | Type:
Full-time, permanent

About the company:

Our client is an established, mid-sized cloud and AI consultancy based in Munich. They are AWS and Azure specialists who design and deliver cloud-native platforms and production AI for enterprise clients, including in automotive, energy and IoT. Their view is that AI should be code running in production.

The opportunity:

They've just won a new enterprise project and need two engineers
to build an agentic AI platform from the ground up:

Lead Cloud & AI Engineer / Technical Architect (up to €100k base).
You'll be the technical spearhead with the client: leading workshops and kick-offs, shaping the architecture and building trust with senior stakeholders, while staying hands-on.
Senior Cloud & AI Engineer (around €85k base).
You'll work alongside the lead and drive hands-on delivery of the platform.

What you'll do:

Design and build agent-based architectures and agentic workflows
Develop RAG systems and provide MCP servers that connect LLMs to enterprise systems
Build cloud-native applications and APIs on AWS and Azure
Implement CI/CD and MLOps pipelines
Work directly with the client, including on-site workshops roughly every six months (travel expenses fully covered)

What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering in Java/Kotlin and/or Python (Spring or Jakarta EE is a plus)
Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain or LangGraph) and ideally MCP
Cloud-native skills: Docker/Podman, Kubernetes/OpenShift, AWS and/or Azure, and CI/CD tools
Confidence working with customers. For the lead role, you'll need a track record as the technical lead in front of clients.
Fluent German (C1 or above)
, because the project and the client are German-speaking

What's on offer:

Up to €100k (lead) or around €85k (senior), depending on experience
Hybrid working from a modern, well-connected Munich office. Candidates around Münster or Hannover will also be considered.
A learning budget for courses and certifications, plus conferences and innovation lab time
Technical freedom, with a greenfield agentic AI build

Process:
a 30-minute intro call, then a 2-hour on-site technical session with the team (including lunch), then an offer. The team moves quickly, and the ideal start is as soon as possible.

Apply now!

jobs.title: C# Developer
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Our Market Technologies and Operations (MTO) division is part of the Global Business Service Unit in Société Générale. We support a wide range of activities, from booking and pricing to contribution and full front-to-back processes for Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities products.

The Trading Tool
team is responsible for developing and maintaining front-office trading applications that are used daily by traders for market making.

As a C# Developer you will play a vital role in the full software development life cycle (SDLC) - designing, building, testing, and deploying high-performance applications. You will work closely with a distributed team (based in France and Poland) in a fast-paced, collaborative environment were English is the main working language.

Your future scope of responsibility will cover
:

Building, delivering, and running applications, using craftsmanship and best coding practices
Developing and supporting features in a functional application chain
Breaking down technical and functional requirements into detailed user stories and collaborating closely with the product owner and business analysts
Delivering and supporting the application via continuous delivery (DevOps)
Writing unit tests, reviewing the code to be delivered and contributing to non-regression testing
Maintaining and improving production support for existing features
Recommending and implementing process and performance improvements
Providing clear, consistent updates to clients and management
Working with the following tech stack: C#, .NET, .NET Framework, ElasticSearch, WPF, MS SQL / PostgreSQL, REST WebAPI, Github, Jenkins, TeamCity, RabbitMQ, Kafka
Methodologies: Agile, TDD

Some milestones to be expected this year:

Migration to .NET8
Opportunistic migration from heavy client to REST API & web User Interface

Required

Profile required

You will be best suited for this role if
:

You have at least 3 years of professional experience in backend software development (C#)
You are proficient in multi-threaded programming and have worked with microservices architecture
You have solid experience with WPF and a strong knowledge of its API design as well as best practices of implementation
You communicate in English confidently
You are a team-player, enjoying knowledge sharing, and are proactive in problem-solving

Why join us

Your future with Societe Generale will include:

Work in a pleasant atmosphere as part of an international team in a brand-new office in the center of Warsaw, designed with facilities for people with disabilities
An active role in an international structure and the opportunity for growth
Access to educational platforms and language courses
Stability
Competitive salary based on seniority and skills
Support in quick adaptation in the company
Extraordinary health package with extensive dental care
Hybrid work (3 office days per week) and one-time bonus for home office equipment
Even more benefits such as meal allowance, holiday fund, sports card and insurance
Please be informed that we will be accepting only resumes in English

Business insight

At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious.

Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA.

If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!

Still hesitating?

You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II (.NET)
jobs.description:
EBS is a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company and part of Alarm.com. Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6+ million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. We’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more.

The Access Control (AC) team
is a blend of full-stack engineers, leaning backend, who build the platform that businesses rely on to secure and manage physical access to their properties. Our services span the full journey of an access control system — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the communication layer that talks directly to panels, card readers, and smart locks in the field. Some examples include enabling multi-site businesses to manage access from a single dashboard, delivering real-time access activity and history to property managers, and keeping thousands of controllers in the field configured, updated, and in sync with the cloud. We’re seeking a Software Engineer II
(Backend-leaning Full-stack) who is passionate about building reliable, scalable systems that bridge cloud software and real-world hardware and wants to see their code open doors — literally — for businesses around the world.

As a Software Engineer II on the Access Control team, you will design, develop, and maintain the backend services that power our access control platform — from cloud APIs and event pipelines down to the systems that communicate with physical controllers and readers in the field. While the role is backend-leaning, you’ll work across the full stack, contributing to our web front end when features call for it. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support your growth as you take on increasing ownership of features and systems.

Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. We are building a new team in Krakow. Our employees work fully from the office with possibility to work remotely occasionally.

Responsibilities

Build and Deliver: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that power our access control platform.
Bridge Cloud and Hardware: Contribute to the device communication layer that connects our cloud platform to access control hardware — panels, readers, and locks — including device configuration, firmware update, and real-time event processing flows.
Contribute Across Layers: Develop features across the full stack, including web front-end features (Ember.js), when projects require it.
Own the Lifecycle: Take part in the entire development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and production monitoring.
Get Hands-On: Work directly with real access control hardware to develop, test, and debug device integrations.
Ensure Quality: Write unit and integration tests, validate features before release, and monitor production performance.
Balance Trade-offs: Exercise good judgment — know when to iterate quickly and when to build for scale, robustness, and maintainability.
Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, hardware/device engineers, and other software teams across time zones.
Grow and Share: Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing — and share your own knowledge as the team grows.
Continuous Improvement: Bring your ideas! We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C# is a plus.
Experience developing backend services and HTTP APIs (REST or similar).
Experience with database design and development (SQL).
Experience with creating and maintaining unit tests; familiarity with integration testing and CI/CD is a plus.
Familiarity with a modern JavaScript framework such as Ember.js, Angular, or React.
Experience working with hardware, IoT, or device development is a plus.
Good communication skills.

Why Work for Alarm.com?

Make an immediate impact — own projects that directly affect the businesses that rely on our security solutions every day.
Work with real-world IoT devices — see your code in action on the access control panels, readers, and locks we integrate with.
Be empowered — take ownership of features, drive technical decisions, and build best-in-class products.
Work with modern technologies — our stack includes C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, and native mobile applications.
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package — Medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

Company Info

Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6 million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. And every day, we're innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more. We're seeking those who are passionate about creating change through technology and who want to make a lasting impact on the world around them.

EBS Sp. z o.o. is a dynamically growing Polish technology company, combining decades of innovation with deep expertise in smart security solutions. We are part of the American corporation Alarm.com, a leading global provider of intelligent security solutions for homes and businesses.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com or ebssmart.com

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to, or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations, such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring compliance with labor laws and regulations, even after we have made our employment decision. We will retain this data for a maximum of 3 years after the end of the recruitment process. The data administrator is EBS Sp. z o.o.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer I - Poland
jobs.description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We Also Offer

Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from
A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace
Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team
Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer I, you serve as a technical leader who drives the architecture and development of complex, high-impact software systems across HCP. You apply deep engineering expertise to ambiguous technical challenges, establish scalable solutions and patterns, and influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate projects. You collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business needs into reliable, performant, and maintainable systems. You also elevate engineering practices through technical mentorship, thoughtful design decisions, and continuous evaluation of emerging technologies and approaches.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

Compensation: 8 200 - 9 700 USD per month (B2B)

What You Do Each Day

Design and implement scalable, high-quality software solutions that address complex business and technical requirements
Lead technical architecture and design decisions for high-impact initiatives across multiple systems
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to define technical requirements, tradeoffs, and implementation approaches
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that establishes and reinforces engineering best practices
Conduct code and design reviews and provide actionable technical guidance to engineering peers
Troubleshoot complex software issues and drive solutions through root-cause analysis and systematic problem solving
Optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability
Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural patterns, and reusable engineering standards
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend approaches that improve engineering quality, efficiency, or scalability
Mentor and support engineers by sharing technical expertise and strengthening engineering capabilities across the team

Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience using programming languages and frameworks (i.e. Ruby on Rails, PHP, Python, JavaScript)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
Experience developing web applications and working with content management systems (i.e. WordPress, Strapi, Contentful)
Strong understanding of designing, building, and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs)
Strong proficiency with version control systems and collaborative development workflows (i.e. Git)
Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, caching mechanisms, and content delivery networks (CDNs)
Experience with performance tuning, memory optimization, and related diagnostic tools
Strong proficiency with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices
Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, and reliability principles
Proven experience driving team efficiency or output quality through the strategic use of AI tools and automation

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Ability to independently develop informed technical perspectives on complex and ambiguous systems
Proactive approach to researching, evaluating, and applying current and emerging technologies
Ability to influence technical direction and collaborate effectively across functions without relying on direct authority
A multi-dimensional background with a breadth of cross-functional interests or depth of specialized mastery
Personal resilience to learn from scratch, and successfully thrive in ambiguity

📌 Our primary technology stack at HCP is Ruby.
To be effective in this role, you’ll need to learn it.
We offer support in the learning process, tailored to your needs and any prior experience with Ruby. This may include mentoring from our experienced engineering team or access to a paid online course that you can complete during working hours as part of your onboarding. The exact form of support will be agreed upon based on insights from your selection process.

Sounds interesting? We're waiting for your resume!

This role is open to candidates in Poland, and the expected salary range for this role is $ + equity. The specific salary for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law.
